machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Bass drum with a tunable body and tail. Shape the front edge with ATK, then adjust TONE and decay to sit it in the mix.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Tunable cowbell with separate detuning and pitch-drop controls. Adjust DEC for a short knock or a longer metallic ring.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Claves with pitch, decay and gate control. Tune the strike and trim its length for compact percussion patterns.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Hand clap with control over the number and spacing of claps. Shape the main decay separately from the reverb tail.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Cymbal with pitch, decay, accent and tone control. Adjust the register and tail length to fit the rhythm.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Hi-hat with a TYPE selector, pitch and decay. Choose its character, then set the length and accent of each hit.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Maracas with pitch, decay and swell control. Use SWEL to shape the onset of the shaker texture.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Rimshot with independent pitch, tone and decay. Tune the knock and shorten the tail for tight rhythmic accents.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Snare with separate TONE and SNAP controls. Balance the drum character and snare edge, then set pitch and decay.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Tom/conga voice with TYPE, tuning and noise controls. Set the drum register and blend in noise for a rougher hit.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Bass drum with tuning, attack, depth and drive controls. Shape the transient and body, then add drive for a harder edge.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Hand clap with adjustable clap count and spacing. Main decay, reverb decay and reverb level let you shape the hit and its tail.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Rimshot with pitch, tone, decay and accent. Tune its register and trim the ring for precise percussive punctuation.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Snare with tone, snap, pitch bend and detuning. Shape both the initial crack and the movement of the drum body.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Tom voice with a TYPE selector, pitch bend and noise. Adjust pitch and decay for fills, then vary the bend and noisy edge.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Electric-piano voice with brightness, feedback and ratio controls. Shape the attack character with velocity and the evolving tone with MDEC.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Bass voice with brightness, feedback and ratio controls. Adjust the decay and modulation decay for a compact or more sustained bass line.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Lead voice with attack, brightness, feedback and ratio controls. Shape its onset and tonal movement, with LFO available for modulation.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Harmonic pad voice with attack, brightness and feedback. Use the amplitude and modulation decays to shape how the sustained texture develops.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Synth-string voice with attack, brightness, feedback and ratio. Adjust the onset and decay for short phrases or longer string-like layers.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: SX-1 filter stage with cutoff, resonance and an attack/decay envelope. T-1 and T-2 set the preceding-track inputs to process.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: TX-3 filter stage with cutoff, resonance, envelope and accent. DEC and LEN shape the articulation; LVL and BST control the output.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: CS-8 filter stage with separate high-pass and low-pass cutoff and resonance. An attack/decay envelope adds movement to the filtered sound.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Filter stage with cutoff, resonance, slope and high-pass controls. Shape the sweep with envelope depth, attack and decay.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Oscillator voice combining saw, pulse, sub and noise. Mix the components and adjust pulse width for bass and lead building blocks.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Oscillator voice with waveform, slide and pulse-width controls. Set pitch and decay, then use SLD for movement between notes.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Oscillator voice with waveform and pulse width plus noise and sine components. MOD and SPD control its modulation.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Dual-oscillator voice with separate waveforms and a mix control. Tune and fine-tune the second oscillator against the first.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: String-and-voice synth with attack, hold and release. VOIC and TONE shape the timbre; vibrato rate and depth add motion.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Bowed-string model with bow speed, pressure and position. Shape the onset, length and damping for different bowing gestures.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Electric-piano model with hardness, bell, bar and bass controls. Balance the components and use decay and release to shape the note.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Handpan model with strike position and hardness. Adjust sympathetic resonance and the GU component alongside pitch and decay.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Piano model with velocity, hardness, detuning, stiffness and body. Shape the strike and resonance, then set note length and decay.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: String model with excitation, strike position and hardness. Damping, detuning and stiffness shape the resonant tail.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Neighbour bus compressor with threshold, ratio, attack and release. Blend dry and compressed audio with MIX and compensate level with MKUP.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Neighbour BBD-style chorus with mode, rate, depth and noise controls. T-1 and T-2 select the contribution from preceding tracks.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Neighbour distortion with drive and tone shaping. Balance the processed signal with MIX and adjust level and output to match the bank.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Neighbour overdrive with drive, tone and wet/dry mix. Adjust level and output alongside the amount of saturation.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Neighbour fuzz with drive, tone and wet/dry mix. Shape the distorted texture and balance its output against the original signal.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Neighbour filter distortion with drive and tone controls. Blend the processed sound with MIX and set its level and output.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Neighbour ensemble effect with rate, depth and wet/dry mix. T-1 through T-4 control the contributions from four preceding tracks.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Neighbour FET-style compressor with input, threshold, ratio, attack and release. Adjust output and neighbour balance after setting compression.

machines.author: MDX
machines.summary: Four-track neighbour mixer. T-1 through T-4 set the levels of the four preceding tracks in one machine.

machines.author: Kitbasher / Simple606 contributors
machines.summary: 606-inspired kick with a tunable, decaying body and adjustable click. Continuous XL extends the body; HEAT shapes its character.
machines.notes: XL is continuous: 0 = normal, 127 = former XL on. Existing XL-on kits need 127. New CLIK defaults to 127.

machines.author: Kitbasher / Simple606 contributors
machines.summary: 606-inspired snare with separate SNAP and BODY levels. Tune the drum and use COLR to adjust the noise character.
machines.notes: For existing kits, set the added layer-level controls to 127 to retain their original balance.

machines.author: Kitbasher / Simple606 contributors
machines.summary: 606-inspired low tom with tuning and decay. NOIS and OVER let you balance the noisy layer and upper overtones against the body.
machines.notes: For existing kits, set the added layer-level controls to 127 to retain their original balance.

machines.author: Kitbasher / Simple606 contributors
machines.summary: 606-inspired high tom with tuning and decay. Adjust NOIS and OVER to change the balance of the attack texture and upper overtones.
machines.notes: For existing kits, set the added layer-level controls to 127 to retain their original balance.

machines.author: Kitbasher / Simple606 contributors
machines.summary: 606-inspired closed hi-hat with tune, decay and metallic-character control. Use METL to vary the texture of short hat patterns.
machines.notes: For existing kits, set METL to 64 to retain the default character.

machines.author: Kitbasher / Simple606 contributors
machines.summary: 606-inspired open hi-hat with tune, decay and metallic-character control. Shape the ringing tail with DEC and its texture with METL.
machines.notes: For existing kits, set METL to 64 to retain the default character.

machines.author: Kitbasher / Simple606 contributors
machines.summary: 606-inspired cymbal with tuning, decay and a separate bell level. Balance the bell component against the longer cymbal texture.
machines.notes: For existing kits, set the added layer-level controls to 127 to retain their original balance.

machines.author: Kitbasher / Simple606 contributors
machines.summary: 606-inspired clap with separate noise and body levels. Set its pitch and decay, then balance NOIS and BODY to shape the hit.
machines.notes: For existing kits, set the added layer-level controls to 127 to retain their original balance.

machines.author: hcar / murdenihcam
machines.summary: Grain-based stretching for UW ROM and internal E12 samples. Stretch to a freeze with TIME; GRAN and FLUX shape the grain texture.
machines.notes: UW required. SMPL 1–48 selects ROM; 49–69 selects E12. TIME reaches a freeze at its maximum; GRAN and FLUX change grain size and variation.

machines.author: hcar / murdenihcam
machines.summary: Grain-based stretching for UW ROM samples 1-48. Choose a playback region, then use TIME, GRAN and FLUX to stretch and vary its texture.
machines.notes: UW required. SMPL selects ROM slots 1–48. TIME reaches a freeze at its maximum; GRAN and FLUX change grain size and variation.

machines.author: hcar / murdenihcam
machines.summary: Grain-based stretching for the 21 internal E12 samples, including non-UW machines. Choose a region and stretch it as far as a freeze.
machines.notes: Works on UW and non-UW models. SMPL selects internal E12 samples 1–21. TIME reaches a freeze at its maximum; GRAN and FLUX change grain size and variation.

machines.author: wftlrd (archive attribution)
machines.summary: K55 rimshot with four controls: pitch, decay, accent and tone. Set the register, length and tonal balance of the strike.
machines.notes: Original K55 package from the user-supplied K55_wftlrd archive. Source, license and hardware qualification were not included. Package bytes and controls are preserved.

machines.author: wftlrd (archive attribution)
machines.summary: K55 cowbell with detuning and fall controls alongside pitch and decay. Vary its tuning relationship and downward movement.
machines.notes: Original K55 package from the user-supplied K55_wftlrd archive. Source, license and hardware qualification were not included. Package bytes and controls are preserved.

machines.author: wftlrd (archive attribution)
machines.summary: K55 hi-hat with pitch, decay, accent and tone. Shape its register and tail length for different hat patterns.
machines.notes: Original K55 package from the user-supplied K55_wftlrd archive. Source, license and hardware qualification were not included. Package bytes and controls are preserved.

machines.author: wftlrd (archive attribution)
machines.summary: K55 cymbal with pitch, decay, accent and tone. Set the ring length and tonal balance for cymbal accents.
